cultural_notes: The Woccon tribe was first documented in 1701 by English Surveyor General John Lawson
Woccon had two villages: Yupwaureau and Tooptatmeer
The Woccon had 150 fighting men with estimated total population of 500-600 individuals
Woccon villages were located about two leagues east of southern Tuscarora villages between the Neuse River and Contentnea Creek
The Woccon were last mentioned in 1712 in a treaty between North Carolina colony and the Tuscarora tribe
The Woccon joined with Tuscarora towns in the Tuscarora wars of 1711-1713
The Woccon were likely absorbed by the Tuscaroras following their defeat and flight from the Carolinas
